notes.title: Major Update Patch Note 039J
notes.content:
[h1]Major Update Patch Note 039J[/h1][p][/p][h2]New Features,[/h2][list][*][p][b]Save/Load System[/b] has been implemented.,[/p][/*][*][p]New [b]Faction Perks[/b] have been implemented.,[/p][/*][*][p][b]Starting Perk System[/b] has been added to the game.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Stolen[/b] Item System has been added[/p][/*][/list][h2]New Content,[/h2][list][*][p]Added a new rare medical injector,[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new unique character storyline,[/p][/*][*][p]Added some regular tourist customers and a tourist event,[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new recurring power outage event[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Blast Furnace Module[/b],[/p][/*][*][p][b]3 New Ultra Rare Items[/b],[/p][/*][*][p][b]Security Requisition Officer[/b]
While you have at least 0 Reputation with Security, a requisition officer may visit to buy supplies.
Selling to them will increase your reputation at a slightly faster rate.,[/p][/*][*][p][b]Food Bank Worker[/b]
A food bank worker may visit to buy food at a 50% discount.
Selling to them will increase your reputation at a faster rate.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Visual Inspection Item[/b],[/p][/*][*][p][b]Extended Storage Bay[/b] has been added,[/p][/*][*][p]Player will now have guaranteed encounters to purchase the [b]Extended Storage Bay,[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]New Contraband Buyer Service[/b] can be unlocked via [b]Joe Wild[/b] — an expansive service with a cooldown that guarantees a high-budget contraband buyer visit[/p][/*][*][p][b]Underground Exchange Promotional Deal[/b],[/p][/*][*][p]Supplier unlocked from Wild has been expanded:,[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The supplier will now track the amount spent.,[/p][/*][*][p]After spending around 350–500 credits (depending on the supplier), the player will unlock an additional dialog option for a larger order.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Changes,[/h2][list][*][p]Ruined Machine introduction day for Junker changed from [b]Day 21 → Day 11[/b].,[/p][/*][*][p]Recharger price reduced from [b]200 → 150[/b].,[/p][/*][*][p]PowerBloc daily recharge rate increased from [b]1 → 2[/b] (and from [b]2 → 3[/b] after Wild’s upgrade).,[/p][/*][*][p]Dr. Jackson’s base budget increased from [b]50 → 100 Credits[/b]. He now gains [b]+3 budget[/b] for each day passed.,[/p][/*][*][p]Dr. Jackson now visits once a week on a fixed day, except during scripted visits.,[/p][/*][*][p]Odin Haraldsson’s cooldown increased from [b]3 → 5[/b].,[/p][/*][*][p]Smuggler’s Bay (and modified variant) can no longer store Storage Bays.,[/p][/*][*][p]Wild’s Fixer now removes [b]15% of available evidence + 50[/b] additional evidence per night when used.,[/p][/*][*][p]Investigation rate now progresses faster when there is a large amount of available evidence.,[/p][/*][*][p]Selling to Odin now contributes [b]33%[/b] (instead of [b]0%[/b]) of the item's value to available evidence.,[/p][/*][*][p]Insurance service cost is now based on a [b]percentage of the total estimated worth[/b], plus a base value.,[/p][/*][*][p]New items can now be obtained through the [b]Dream Dust Exchange[/b] deal.,[/p][/*][*][p]Some Exchange deals have been updated.,[/p][/*][*][p]Odin will refuse to visit if called during a crackdown.,[/p][/*][*][p]Odin will buy contraband items at [b]half the contraband bonus value[/b].,[/p][/*][*][p]Moisture Farm base output increased from [b]250ml → 350ml[/b].,[/p][/*][*][p]Rustwater from the upgraded tap now yields lower purity.,[/p][/*][*][p]Minimum purity of Gutterflow from the tap has been increased.,[/p][/*][*][p]Tap water now has a [b]fixed purity per day[/b]. Players can no longer "reroll" water purity by rechecking.,[/p][/*][*][p]Generic Scav spawn rate has been adjusted to favor [b]less expensive items[/b] in the first few days.,[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the price of some medical items,[/p][/*][*][p]Improved loot contents in Medical Supply Crates,[/p][/*][*][p]Inspection bribing now has a defined minimum and maximum value,[/p][/*][*][p]Inspection bribe costs increase as the in-game day counter goes up[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]Generalist[/b] start now includes [b]1 Storage Bay[/b] and a selection of merchandise.,[/p][/*][*][p]Reputation penalty for reporting a contraband seller to their faction increased: [b]-5 → -8[/b],[/p][/*][*][p]Lower Level reputation gain from traded items is now [b]66%[/b] of the trade value instead of [b]100%[/b].,[/p][/*][*][p][b]PowerBloc[/b] upgraded commercial power recharge rate increased: [b]3 → 4[/b],[/p][/*][*][p]Trading with the [b]Underground Exchange[/b] now generates [b]0.33 Reputation[/b] per deal.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Alert[/b] Starting Perk: Point Cost increased from [b]1 → 2[/b],[/p][/*][*][p]You now lose [b]10 Security reputation[/b] if an investigation ends with a fine,[/p][/*][*][p]You now lose [b]20 Security reputation[/b] when using evidence removal service,[/p][/*][*][p]Most UI windows will now close automatically when going to sleep,[/p][/*][*][p][b]Small Kotton Fiber[/b] base price: 24 → 22 credits,[/p][/*][*][p][b]Large Kotton Fiber[/b] base price: 32 → 36 credits,[/p][/*][*][p][b]Synaprest Injector[/b] base price updated: 180 → 250 credits,[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ashish[/b] will now accept to buy [b]Chemical Supplies[/b] when dropping off your order,[/p][/*][*][p][b]Hardmode[/b] no longer displays event durations,[/p][/*][*][p][b]Naloxgone Injector[/b] base price: 15 → 30 credits,[/p][/*][*][p][b]Merchant[/b] and [b]Shady Merchant[/b] budgets now scale with days passed,[/p][/*][*][p]Selling to the [b]Shady Merchant[/b] now yields only [b]half of the contraband bonus[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Improved how Plasma Fuel is generated.,[/p][/*][*][p]Nightly report now features color coding.,[/p][/*][*][p]Some “Regular Customers” now scale better into the late game:[/p][list][*][p]Budgets increase as days pass.,[/p][/*][*][p]Stock volume increases around days [b]20[/b], [b]40[/b], and [b]70[/b].,[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Fence now starts with less initial contraband merchandise.,[/p][/*][*][p]Fence now starts with a [b]standard Smuggler’s Bay[/b] instead of the modified variant.,[/p][/*][*][p][b]Modified Smuggler Bay[/b] can now be obtained through the [b]Underground Exchange[/b].,[/p][/*][*][p][b]Smuggler Bay storage size[/b] increased: 4x4 → 5x5.,[/p][/*][*][p]You now receive an additional [b]50 base credit reward[/b] for reporting customers selling contraband or stolen goods.,[/p][/*][*][p]Player loses reputation if contraband or stolen items are found during inspection.,[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]\[Low-tech][/b] tag. Some firearms are now [b]\[Low-tech][/b] instead of [b]\[Makeshift][/b].,[/p][/*][*][p][b]Supply Crates[/b] can no longer hold any [b]\[Storage][/b] items.[/p][/*][*][p]Reputation loss during security inspections is now based on the item’s base value and contraband level.,[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Security Alarm Rework,[/h2][list][*][p]Security Alarm effect from modules: [b]performance bonus on theft prevention has been doubled[/b].,[/p][/*][*][p]A new [b]specialized module[/b] for the alarm system has been implemented.,[/p][/*][/list][h2]Cryptographic Desequencer,[/h2][list][*][p]Now has a [b]standard module inventory[/b].,[/p][/*][*][p]Different chips require different work amounts, with [b]Command chips[/b] requiring the most.,[/p][/*][/list][h2]Phone Rework,[/h2][list][*][p]Now displays whether a [b]phone client is on cooldown[/b].,[/p][/*][*][p][b]Quick dial[/b] feature added for previously dialed numbers.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Stolen Item Mechanic,[/h2][list][*][p]Items can now have the [b]\[Stolen][/b] tag.,[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[Stolen][/b] items have a Heat % that diminishes each day. When Heat reaches 0%, the item loses its [b]\[Stolen][/b] tag.,[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[Stolen] \[Contraband][/b] items take longer for their Heat % to diminish.,[/p][/*][*][p]Selling [b]\[Stolen][/b] items is a crime.,[/p][/*][*][p]Buying [b]\[Stolen][/b] items usually comes at a discount.,[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[Stolen][/b] items are treated like [b]\[Contraband][/b] by security and will be seized if seen or found in the shop.,[/p][/*][*][p]Heat % determines how likely a stolen item is to be detected during inspection.[/p][/*][*][p]Items below 25 base value will no longer carry the stolen tag but will also no longer receive the five-finger discount.,[/p][/*][*][p]Items below 50, 85, and 140 base value will start with 25%, 50%, and 75% heat respectively.,[/p][/*][*][p]Stolen items placed inside the display case are not 100% guaranteed to summon an inspector; it now depends on the item's heat percentage.,[/p][/*][*][p]Showing a stolen item to security is no longer 100% guaranteed to result in an inspection; it now depends on the item’s heat.,[/p][/*][*][p]Placing a stolen item on the counter just before a security officer arrives is also not 100% guaranteed to trigger an inspection; it is based on the item’s heat.,[/p][/*][*][p]The five-finger discount has multiple tiers depending on the item’s heat.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Engineering Supply Crate,[/h2][list][*][p]There is now a very high chance of finding a screwdriver and wire cutter.,[/p][/*][*][p]Chance of finding a capped neural core increased from 1% → 4%.,[/p][/*][*][p]Screwdrivers and wire cutters will sometimes appear in the Bartering Addict’s wares.,[/p][/*][/list][h2]Quality of Life,[/h2][list][*][p]It is now possible to skip phone dialog just like normal dialog by pressing the spacebar.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Bug Fixes,[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where unlocked supply crates bug out after saving and reloading,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the save menu shows a game start as "Unknown Start Type" after saving and reloading,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where loaded items don't have their feature labels,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the Mentor’s note displays with default text after loading,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the Power Hijack upgrade doesn't work,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where loaded supply crates can be opened without unlocking them first,[/p][/*][*][p]Loaded items now correctly display their sprites[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where Lower Level gunsmiths would visit one after another.,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where supply crates and machines could no longer fit into the smuggler’s bay.,[/p][/*][*][p]Containers will no longer include the total item value of locked containers.,[/p][/*][*][p]Odin will no longer answer the phone while present at the store.,[/p][/*][*][p]Barter customers can no longer be interrupted by placing an item before they start their main dialogue.,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the intel slip from the Lower Level Reputation perk was given without displaying the event name.,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a critical bug where certain item labels were not saved or loaded properly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where customers forgot the player’s starting scenario after reloading,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where items inside the trashcan were incorrectly loaded after reloading,[/p][/*][*][p]Only seeds can now be stored inside seed packs,[/p][/*][*][p]Broken machines now load with the correct name and sprite,[/p][/*][*][p]Reputation Perk UI will no longer overflow off the screen,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where selling items to Dr. Jackson gave incorrect discounts when the Lower Levels perk was unlocked,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed event names not displaying correctly on item labels,[/p][/*][*][p]Removed the minimum 2-night cap on the Desequencer,[/p][/*][*][p]Faucets now show the correct tooltip after loading,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a hardlock caused by a dialogue bug after showing contraband to a security officer,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where security officers didn’t react to contraband inserted into the display case during dialogue[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where machines could be stolen.,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where alarms didn’t work if a ruined alarm was in the inventory.,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where Odin could be called after being captured by Security.,[/p][/*][*][p]You can no longer dial numbers longer than 9 digits on the phone.,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the Underground Dream Dust deal only took one Dream Dust.,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where some item types were not saved correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed translation-related display bugs,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Wild Assistant dialogue bugs,[/p][/*][*][p]Furnace will no longer waste energy and input items if the output inventory is full,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused the same normal client to visit multiple times in a single day[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused certain shopper/buyer clients to visit up to [b]3 times a day[/b],[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that allowed consumption of [b]non-owned items[/b] related to addiction,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that allowed [b]non-owned water containers[/b] to be inserted into the hydroponic system,[/p][/*][*][p][b]Private Security Contractors[/b] will no longer accept makeshift weapons,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that allowed the player to [b]close the shutter[/b] while an arrest was in progress[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug causing certain clients' cooldowns to be ignored,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where Hard Mode was not saved,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the label UI did not display the Immunivax pricing modifier[/p][/*][*][p]Blabbermouth penalty is now correctly calculated.,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where [b]Upper Level Volunteers[/b] would appear but give nothing.,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug preventing genuine [b]Lower Level Plasma Fuel[/b] from spawning.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug with Upper Level Volunteer.,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where security inspectors would ignore the trashcan.,[/p][/*][*][p]Five-finger discount is now automatically applied when an item is dropped on the client (front) counter.,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where all incorrect food stamps had at least one incorrect amount error.,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where security inspectors would forget to confiscate the original spotted stolen item that triggered the inspection.,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a UI display issue with visual inspection using Immunivax.,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where broken Immunivax items were not displayed correctly.,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the player was being charged twice for the bribe during inspections.[/p][/*][/list]

tags.feature: [b]Save/Load System[/b] has been implemented.,
New [b]Faction Perks[/b] have been implemented.,
[b]Starting Perk System[/b] has been added to the game.
[b]Stolen[/b] Item System has been added
Added a new rare medical injector,
Added a new unique character storyline,
Added some regular tourist customers and a tourist event,
Added a new recurring power outage event
[b]New Blast Furnace Module[/b],
[b]3 New Ultra Rare Items[/b],

[b]Security Requisition Officer[/b]
While you have at least 0 Reputation with Security, a requisition officer may visit to buy supplies.
Selling to them will increase your reputation at a slightly faster rate.,

[b]Food Bank Worker[/b]
A food bank worker may visit to buy food at a 50% discount.
Selling to them will increase your reputation at a faster rate.
[b]New Visual Inspection Item[/b],
[b]Extended Storage Bay[/b] has been added,
Player will now have guaranteed encounters to purchase the [b]Extended Storage Bay,[/b]
[b]New Contraband Buyer Service[/b] can be unlocked via [b]Joe Wild[/b] — an expansive service with a cooldown that guarantees a high-budget contraband buyer visit
[b]Underground Exchange Promotional Deal[/b],
Supplier unlocked from Wild has been expanded:,
The supplier will now track the amount spent.,
After spending around 350–500 credits (depending on the supplier), the player will unlock an additional dialog option for a larger order.

tags.balance_change: Ruined Machine introduction day for Junker changed from [b]Day 21 → Day 11[/b].,
Recharger price reduced from [b]200 → 150[/b].,
PowerBloc daily recharge rate increased from [b]1 → 2[/b] (and from [b]2 → 3[/b] after Wild’s upgrade).,
Dr. Jackson’s base budget increased from [b]50 → 100 Credits[/b]. He now gains [b]+3 budget[/b] for each day passed.,
Odin Haraldsson’s cooldown increased from [b]3 → 5[/b].,
Wild’s Fixer now removes [b]15% of available evidence + 50[/b] additional evidence per night when used.,
Investigation rate now progresses faster when there is a large amount of available evidence.,
Selling to Odin now contributes [b]33%[/b] (instead of [b]0%[/b]) of the item's value to available evidence.,
Insurance service cost is now based on a [b]percentage of the total estimated worth[/b], plus a base value.,
New items can now be obtained through the [b]Dream Dust Exchange[/b] deal.,
Some Exchange deals have been updated.,
Odin will refuse to visit if called during a crackdown.,
Odin will buy contraband items at [b]half the contraband bonus value[/b].,
Moisture Farm base output increased from [b]250ml → 350ml[/b].,
Rustwater from the upgraded tap now yields lower purity.,
Minimum purity of Gutterflow from the tap has been increased.,
Tap water now has a [b]fixed purity per day[/b]. Players can no longer "reroll" water purity by rechecking.,
Generic Scav spawn rate has been adjusted to favor [b]less expensive items[/b] in the first few days.,
Increased the price of some medical items,
Improved loot contents in Medical Supply Crates,
Inspection bribing now has a defined minimum and maximum value,
Inspection bribe costs increase as the in-game day counter goes up
The [b]Generalist[/b] start now includes [b]1 Storage Bay[/b] and a selection of merchandise.,
Reputation penalty for reporting a contraband seller to their faction increased: [b]-5 → -8[/b],
Lower Level reputation gain from traded items is now [b]66%[/b] of the trade value instead of [b]100%[/b].,
[b]PowerBloc[/b] upgraded commercial power recharge rate increased: [b]3 → 4[/b],
Trading with the [b]Underground Exchange[/b] now generates [b]0.33 Reputation[/b] per deal.,
[b]Alert[/b] Starting Perk: Point Cost increased from [b]1 → 2[/b],
You now lose [b]10 Security reputation[/b] if an investigation ends with a fine,
You now lose [b]20 Security reputation[/b] when using evidence removal service,
[b]Small Kotton Fiber[/b] base price: 24 → 22 credits,
[b]Large Kotton Fiber[/b] base price: 32 → 36 credits,
[b]Synaprest Injector[/b] base price updated: 180 → 250 credits,
[b]Ashish[/b] will now accept to buy [b]Chemical Supplies[/b] when dropping off your order,
[b]Hardmode[/b] no longer displays event durations,
[b]Naloxgone Injector[/b] base price: 15 → 30 credits,
[b]Merchant[/b] and [b]Shady Merchant[/b] budgets now scale with days passed,
Selling to the [b]Shady Merchant[/b] now yields only [b]half of the contraband bonus[/b]
Improved how Plasma Fuel is generated.,
Nightly report now features color coding.,

Some “Regular Customers” now scale better into the late game:
Budgets increase as days pass.,
Stock volume increases around days [b]20[/b], [b]40[/b], and [b]70[/b].,
Fence now starts with less initial contraband merchandise.,
Fence now starts with a [b]standard Smuggler’s Bay[/b] instead of the modified variant.,
[b]Modified Smuggler Bay[/b] can now be obtained through the [b]Underground Exchange[/b].,
[b]Smuggler Bay storage size[/b] increased: 4x4 → 5x5.,
You now receive an additional [b]50 base credit reward[/b] for reporting customers selling contraband or stolen goods.,
Player loses reputation if contraband or stolen items are found during inspection.,
Added [b]\ [Low-tech][/b] tag. Some firearms are now [b]\ [Low-tech][/b] instead of [b]\ [Makeshift][/b].,
[b]Supply Crates[/b] can no longer hold any [b]\ [Storage][/b] items.,
Reputation loss during security inspections is now based on the item’s base value and contraband level.,

tags.feature: Security Alarm effect from modules: [b]performance bonus on theft prevention has been doubled[/b].,
A new [b]specialized module[/b] for the alarm system has been implemented.,
Now has a [b]standard module inventory[/b].,
Different chips require different work amounts, with [b]Command chips[/b] requiring the most.,
Now displays whether a [b]phone client is on cooldown[/b].,
[b]Quick dial[/b] feature added for previously dialed numbers.,
Items can now have the [b]\ [Stolen][/b] tag.,
[b]\ [Stolen][/b] items have a Heat % that diminishes each day. When Heat reaches 0%, the item loses its [b]\ [Stolen][/b] tag.,
[b]\ [Stolen] \ [Contraband][/b] items take longer for their Heat % to diminish.,
Selling [b]\ [Stolen][/b] items is a crime.,
Buying [b]\ [Stolen][/b] items usually comes at a discount.,
[b]\ [Stolen][/b] items are treated like [b]\ [Contraband][/b] by security and will be seized if seen or found in the shop.,
Heat % determines how likely a stolen item is to be detected during inspection.,
Items below 25 base value will no longer carry the stolen tag but will also no longer receive the five-finger discount.,
Items below 50, 85, and 140 base value will start with 25%, 50%, and 75% heat respectively.,
Stolen items placed inside the display case are not 100% guaranteed to summon an inspector; it is now depends on the item's heat percentage.,
Showing a stolen item to security is no longer 100% guaranteed to result in an inspection; it now depends on the item’s heat.,
Placing a stolen item on the counter just before a security officer arrives is also not 100% guaranteed to trigger an inspection; it is based on the item’s heat.,
The five-finger discount has multiple tiers depending on the item’s heat.,
There is now a very high chance of finding a screwdriver and wire cutter.,
Chance of finding a capped neural core increased from 1% → 4%.,
Screwdrivers and wire cutters will sometimes appear in the Bartering Addict’s wares.,
It is now possible to skip phone dialog just like normal dialog by pressing the spacebar.,

tags.bug: Fixed a bug where unlocked supply crates bug out after saving and reloading,
Fixed a bug where the save menu shows a game start as "Unknown Start Type" after saving and reloading
Fixed a bug where loaded items don't have their feature labels,
Fixed a bug where the Mentor’s note displays with default text after loading,
Fixed a bug where the Power Hijack upgrade doesn't work,
Fixed a bug where loaded supply crates can be opened without unlocking them first,
Loaded items now correctly display their sprites
Fixed a bug where Lower Level gunsmiths would visit one after another.,
Fixed a bug where supply crates and machines could no longer fit into the smuggler’s bay.,
Containers will no longer include the total item value of locked containers.,
Odin will no longer answer the phone while present at the store.,
Barter customers can no longer be interrupted by placing an item before they start their main dialogue.,
Fixed a bug where the intel slip from the Lower Level Reputation perk was given without displaying the event name.,
Fixed a critical bug where certain item labels were not saved or loaded properly.
Fixed a bug where customers forgot the player’s starting scenario after reloading,
Fixed a bug where items inside the trashcan were incorrectly loaded after reloading,
Only seeds can now be stored inside seed packs,
Broken machines now load with the correct name and sprite,
Reputation Perk UI will no longer overflow off the screen,
Fixed a bug where selling items to Dr. Jackson gave incorrect discounts when the Lower Levels perk was unlocked,
Fixed event names not displaying correctly on item labels,
Removed the minimum 2-night cap on the Desequencer,
Faucets now show the correct tooltip after loading,
Fixed a hardlock caused by a dialogue bug after showing contraband to a security officer,
Fixed a bug where security officers didn’t react to contraband inserted into the display case during dialogue
Fixed a bug where machines could be stolen.,
Fixed a bug where alarms didn’t work if a ruined alarm was in the inventory.,
Fixed a bug where Odin could be called after being captured by Security.,
You can no longer dial numbers longer than 9 digits on the phone.,
Fixed a bug where the Underground Dream Dust deal only took one Dream Dust.,
Fixed a bug where some item types were not saved correctly.,
Fixed translation-related display bugs,
Fixed Wild Assistant dialogue bugs,
Furnace will no longer waste energy and input items if the output inventory is full,
Fixed a bug that caused the same normal client to visit multiple times in a single day
Fixed a bug that caused certain shopper/buyer clients to visit up to [b]3 times a day[/b],
Fixed a bug that allowed consumption of [b]non-owned items[/b] related to addiction,
Fixed a bug that allowed [b]non-owned water containers[/b] to be inserted into the hydroponic system,
[b]Private Security Contractors[/b] will no longer accept makeshift weapons,
Fixed a bug that allowed the player to [b]close the shutter[/b] while an arrest was in progress
Fixed a bug causing certain clients' cooldowns to be ignored,
Fixed a bug where Hard Mode was not saved,
Fixed a bug where the label UI did not display the Immunivax pricing modifier
Blabbermouth penalty is now correctly calculated.,
Fixed a bug where [b]Upper Level Volunteers[/b] would appear but give nothing.,
Fixed a bug preventing genuine [b]Lower Level Plasma Fuel[/b] from spawning.,
Fixed a bug with Upper Level Volunteer.,
Fixed a bug where security inspectors would ignore the trashcan.,
Five-finger discount is now automatically applied when an item is dropped on the client (front) counter.,
Fixed a bug where all incorrect food stamps had at least one incorrect amount error.,
Fixed a bug where security inspectors would forget to confiscate the original spotted stolen item that triggered the inspection.,
Fixed a UI display issue with visual inspection using Immunivax.,
Fixed a bug where broken Immunivax items were not displayed correctly.,
Fixed a bug where the player was being charged twice for the bribe during inspections.,

notes.title: Patch Notes: 038B + 038C
notes.content: [h2]New Content[/h2]  [list]    [*]New Hydroponic crop: Fillerweed[/*]    [*]New Hydroponic crop: Hydro Reed[/*]    [*]Machine Bay has been added, a new storage item capable of storing machines[/*]    [*]Dr. Jackson will now sell the Machine Bay[/*]    [*]Hydroponic Smuggler Module added, removes seed’s contraband status while the seed is growing[/*]    [*]PowerBloc added, a new item from Dr. Jackson that recharges adjacent batteries and batteries inside adjacent machines when power is paid[/*]    [*]A new Hydroponic Module Bay Expansion Kit has been added[/*]    [*]A new underground Exchange deal has been added to sell poison[/*]    [*]Poison tag has been added to certain items[/*]  [/list]  [h2]Changes[/h2]  [list]    [*]Dr. Jackson will now sell Hydroponic Farm[/*]    [*]Spawn chance for Plant Analyzer and Water Analyzer has been improved with Dr. Jackson[/*]    [*]Hydroponic Start will now start with slightly more credit and battery charge[/*]    [*]Hydroponic Start also spawns with 2 Fillerweed seeds[/*]    [*]Hydroponic and Fence Start’s starting rent has been slightly lowered[/*]    [*]Odin will now accept poison[/*]    [*]Aqua Scan is now also sold by notes.title: Patch Note 038A Hydroponic Farmer
notes.content:
[h1]Hydroponic Farmer Content Update[/h1]
[list]
[*] New Hydroponic Starting Scenario: Hydroponic Farmer is now available.
[*] Hydroponic Farm has 3 crops available to farm.
[*] Introduced a Plant Analyzer as a mid-game upgrade — provides full information on seed stats.
[/list]

[h1]New Content & Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Retired Merchant added for both Water Merchant and Hydroponic Farmer starts.
[*] Service Supply Crate has been added.
[*] New weapons and weapon variants introduced.
[*] Module Extractor is now also sold by the Supply Runner (formerly Supplier).
[*] New medical item added.
[*] Options Menu: Added toggle to automatically call the next customer after the previous one leaves.
[*] Changes & Improvements
[*] Prices and yields of broken machines have been balanced.
[*] Fence start now begins with more credits but has a higher starting rent.
[*] Supplier renamed to Supply Runner to avoid confusion with other Supplier types.
[*] Pile of Scrap loot table updated with more variety.
[*] Scav Addict’s item list expanded.
[*] Generic Scav now guarantees at least one item.
[*] Transfer Button (under the counter) can now move non-owned items from the customer side to negotiation.
[*] Salvaging ruined machines now drops resources into the same inventory; fallback to others if full.
[*] Barter Offer Client will no longer take unrelated counter items during transactions.
[*] Calendar now displays the store’s buy price.
[*] Event system improvements:
[*] Duplicate event IDs will now replace existing ones.
[*] Added safety checks to prevent incompatible events from running together.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where stuck modules could be repaired while still stuck.
[*] Fixed Food Stamps being marked as genuine despite missing required seals.
[*] You can no longer use a non-owned electronic to fix a corrupted module.
[*] Fixed Loan Shark causing a hard-lock when asked to return in a week.
[*] Journal left on the counter will no longer trigger the Thief without an item for sale.
[*] Janitor now correctly removes all intended items.
[*] Fixed a crash in the inventory UI when dragging a pipe onto another pipe.
[*] Ruined moisture farm sprite no longer reverts when a water bottle is inserted.
[*] Fixed pink post-it showing incorrect nightly report info.
[*] Landlord now charges the correct rent if the previous payment was missed.
[/list]

notes.title: Content Update Patch Notes 037A
notes.content:
[h1]New Content[/h1]
[h2]Ruined Machine System[/h2]
[list]
[*] Ruined machines have been added to the game.
[*] After Day 21 (Junker only) or earlier via Wild’s Network unlock, Scrappers may begin visiting the store to sell ruined machines.
[*] Ruined machines can be scrapped using a Welder, Screwdriver, and Wirecutter.
[*] Some ruined machines contain stuck modules, which require the new Module Extractor tool.
[*] Retired Junkers now visit weekly (if the player started as a Junker), offering a stock of essential supplies.
[*] Corrupted Modules can now be restored using Electronic Parts, converting them into Blank Modules (rewriting functionality coming in a future update).
[/list]

[h2]Other Additions[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added new melee weapons to the item pool.
[*] Introduced a new market event: Weapon Shortage.
[*] Added a new fallback newspaper article: "All Quiet", which appears when no other events are active.
[*] Introduced a new Supplier Customer who visits weekly with a fixed inventory (e.g. water filters, smelting flux) sold at a premium.
[/list]

[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Commissary stock of Processed Juice and Processed Milk now fluctuates with food-related events.
[*] Security actions (fines, arrests) triggered at 100 evidence level can now be canceled using Wild’s Service if the officer is already in the queue.
[*] Generic Scavengers now have an increased chance to sell melee weapons.
[*] Expanded Counter Space allows customers with larger inventories to display all their items.
[*] Water measurements now display in milliliters (ml) without decimal places for a cleaner UI.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where certain customers could be interrupted, preventing them from displaying their goods.
[*] Fixed an issue where the retail markup feature was not removed correctly when a customer left under specific conditions.
[*] Fixed a bug where contraband was not properly detected when calling security on a client.
[*] Increased the credit reward for snitching on a contraband seller.
[*] Resolved a visual bug where true water purity was incorrectly shown alongside the intended value.
[*] Fixed a broken rent/mortgage day counter that stopped after the first payment.
[*] Updated the "Skip Intro" start to include missing items like the Republic logo checker and Mentor’s Notes.
[*] Fixed a bug where water container labels would reset after pouring into another container.
[*] Fixed logic in Georgio’s cigarette encounter where he would deny the box issue incorrectly.
[*] Addressed a timing issue with phone customers (e.g., Odin) arriving too early or late. They now arrive after the correct delay.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Note 036A: Water Trader Content Update
notes.content:
[h1]New Content Related to Water:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Water Merchant Start – Now unlocked! Players starting as a Water Merchant will begin with everything needed to jump straight in.
[*] New Water Testing Device – Functions like the water testing strip but has unlimited uses and displays the exact composition of the water’s contaminants.
[*] Water Purifier – A new machine that work overnight and can reliably purify water. By default, it can only purify water up to High Quality. Using modules, it can be upgraded to produce Pure Water (+100% Quality is required to achieve Pure Water).
[*] Crime Increase for Selling Mislabeled Water – Selling large quantities of mislabeled water will increase your crime level over time, even if you weren’t exposed when selling.
[*] Expanded Water Trading Guide – The Water Trading Guide now includes more pages.
[*] New Water Trading Customers –  new customers related to trading water has been added.
[*] Reworked Existing Water Buyers and Sellers – Improved the behavior and interactions with existing water customers.
[*] New Drain in the Shop – Allows you to dump unwanted water while keeping the bottle.
[*] New Bottle Printer – Dispenses empty small water bottles in exchange for energy.
[/list]

[h1]New Content:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Storage Bay – Dr. Jackson now sells a Storage Bay (10x10 space), allowing the player to store additional items. It can store everything except other containers.
[*] New Unique Customer – A new unique customer has been added with their own storyline.
[*] Changes:
[*] Reduced Price of High Quality and Pure Water – Prices have been adjusted to balance the game.
[*] Odin’s Expanded Buying List – Odin will now buy all types of supply crates, including those from the evidence locker.
[*] Odin's Budget Increase – Every item sold to Odin will permanently increase his future budget at a conversion rate of 15%, up to a maximum of 1,500 credits.
[*] "Skip Dialogue" Improvement – Pressing the spacebar will now skip the wait time between lines, allowing players to speed through dialogue more quickly.
[*] Balanced Pricing for Water Testing Strip and Tablet
[*] Quick Transfer to Garbage Bin – Players can now use Alt-Click to quickly transfer items to the garbage bin.
[*] Improved Debug Panel UX – Enhanced the Debug Panel (F9) for better usability.
[*] Cleaned Up Debug Spawner – Removed unused items from the debug spawner.
[*] Dynamic Wanted Customer Spawning – Certain wanted customers will now spawn dynamically based on game state.
[*] Metal Ingot Labeling Restriction – Metal Ingot labels can no longer be edited (temporary, until related customer are reworked).
[*] Event Cooldowns – Events now have a cooldown period after ending.
[*] Rent Indicator Improvement – The rent indicator will now include unpaid rent from the previous week if the rent grace period was activated.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented players from selling certain items at a loss.
[*] Fixed a game-breaking bug where selecting or dragging an item during confiscation would bug the game until restart.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented the "Dialogue Speed" slider from working properly.
[*] Fixed a bug that kept perk tooltips open when the reputation UI was closed using the ESC key.
[*] Fixed an issue where supply crates could store other containers.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented the commissary from losing stock during shortages.
[*] Fixed pricing errors when selling items within containers during an active event.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Note 035G
notes.content:
Cumulative patch note for hotfix 035E, 035G and 035G

[h1]Changes Related to the Incoming Water Update:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Reworked the water testing strip.
[*] Added a water trading manual, which currently includes only a Quickstart section.
[*] Added a proper introduction to water trading mechanics.
[*] Improved interactions when selling mislabeled items.
[*] Currently, only cigarettes and water can be relabeled.
[*] Different buyers will react differently to mislabeled items.
[/list]

[h1]New Content:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added a new extended capacity power cell to reduce the need for frequent battery swaps.
[/list]

[h1]Changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] The Security Inspector will no longer visit more than once per day, regardless of active events.
[*] Crime level will no longer degrade if evidence level is above 80.
[*] Improved dossier sprite.
[*] Water containers now have different sprites based on the volume of water inside.
[*] Thieves and Dr. Jackson now have a chance to sell Cryptographic Desequencer Chips, which were previously unobtainable.
[*] Added a new credits and acknowledgments UI in the main menu.
[*] Players now gain 1 reputation for every 200 credits traded with a faction instead of every 250 credits.
[*] Officer Lun will now visit a 2nd time to talk about reporting contraband seller which was a previously unexplained but implemented features 
[*] Some visual inspection elements were changed to make them more obvious.
[*] Food stamp visual inspection has been enlarged for better visibility.
[*] Light wear and heavy wear images in the fuel guide are now larger.
[*] Heavy wear on fuel is now more visually prominent.
[*] Dr. Jackson now has a guaranteed spawn on Day 3 in Skip Intro mode.
[*] Dr. Jackson will start spawning earlier in Skip Intro mode.
[*] Dr. Jackson will now also sell fully charged batteries.
[*] Improved the Desequencer to make its current state clearer.
[*] Fixed a bug where commissary item stock didn’t decrease after purchase.
[*] Some customers will now place their items in the middle of the counter.
[/list]

Bug Fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where reporting a contraband seller who is coming to barter would result in security failing to recognize them as a contraband trader.
[*] Fixed a bug where the labeler and labeler tutorial were not given in Skip Intro mode.
[*] Fixed a bug where a non-owned supply crate could be unlocked with a keycard.
[*] Fixed a bug where selling a container after opening it still allowed access to the items inside.
[*] Fixed a sprite error with the letter 'R' in food stamp inspection.
[*] Fixed a bug where the "Sick Scav" NPC would not sell the bottle they presented.
[*] Fixed a bug where non-owned items could be inserted into the smuggler’s bay.
[*] Fixed various grammar errors.
[*] Removed a scavenger who asked to barter for moonshine before the feature was implemented.
[*] Fixed a bug where calling security while a client was leaving could hardlock the game.
[*] Fixed a bug where interrupting certain customers would prevent them from presenting their items.
[*] Soda and beer are now classified as beverages.
[*] The good inspection discount now applies to water as well.
[*] Fixed Officer Lun’s incorrect sprite on his second visit.
[*] The appraisal board certificate can no longer be stolen.
[/list]

The magnifying glass can now be stored inside the dossier and the new inspection handbook.
The wanted list will now be crossed out when a suspect is arrested by security.
Skip Intro start mode will now guarantee two seller customers on the first day.

notes.title: Patch Note 035
notes.content:
[h2]Security Mechanic Expansion:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Security will now track your crimes when you commit them, such as trading contraband or bribing security.
[*] Trading contraband with certain customers will not increase (or will only slightly increase) your tracked crime level. Example: trading with a Revolutionary faction customer (no increase) and the black market (50% increase).
[*] The Mentor will give you your security record after your first crime is committed. (If "Skip Intro" is selected, you will start with the record.)
[*] The security record contains what security knows about your criminal activities. It is always up-to-date.
[*] Depending on your crime level, your evidence level will increase at the start of each day. The higher your crime level, the faster the evidence level rises. If it reaches 100, security will issue a fine, arrest, or execution depending on your crime level.
[*] Your crime level will decay slowly at the start of each day.
[*] Security will react to certain crimes when an activity reaches a threshold. Example: inspections will become more frequent if a lot of contraband trafficking is on record, and a reliable inspector will be sent if a significant amount of bribery is committed.
[/list]

[h2]Debug Menu, New Features (F9 Menu):[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added "Force Close Shutter" button.
[*] Added "Force Open Shutter" button.
[*] Added “Force Clear Trashcan” button.
[*] Added “Spawn Crates & Cards” Button
[/list]

[h2]Change:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Supplier contact unlock from Wild’s network will provide free sample on the first phone call
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where If you pay for insider info before they finish speaking, It'll bug out and won't give you the information.
[*] Improved code logic in Dialog System. Bugs related to dialog should be less frequent now
[*] Attempted to fix a bug related to shutter door being bugged out and not able to open.
[*] Inspector can no longer inspect item inside locked crates
[*] Fixed a bug where you can expose counterfeit food stamp twice
[*] Fixed a bug where dialog choices remains after a customer is arrested
[*] Fixed a bug where new customer discount is displayed but not applied when paying
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Note 034C
notes.content:
Bug fixes:

-Fixed a bug where non-owned items can be “stolen” by inserted them into The Hidden storage
-Fixed many grammar mistakes (Thanks to help from our Discord Community)
-Fixed a bug in visual inspection UI where 2 different items can overlap
-Fixed a bug where an item can still be found during inspection when stored inside the Smuggler Bay
-Fixed where Joe Wild can’t be reached via phone when started with Skip Intro option
-Reworked the tutorial bubbles
-Fixed a bug where an item is transferred to an outside counter when using quick transfer on an item in a container. The item will now be transfer only to the main inventory area
-Fixed where a resource surplus event can happen at the same time as the same resource shortage event
-Fixed the bug that cause dragged item to reset when dragging over a UI element
